reference: T003 native project compile in WeChat DevTools and Simulator observation of the FE-001 engineering bootstrap page (existing 小树荫助手 project, AppID wx746a39363f67ae95)

design.selector: 微信开发者工具负责原生项目编译、预览与上传

environment: macOS 26.6.2 arm64; WeChat DevTools cask 2.02.2609250 (app build 36.6.0), CLI server 127.0.0.1:32562, CLI login true; base library 3.18.1; AppID wx746a39363f67ae95; TypeScript compiler plugin; candidate branch feat/001-wechat-runtime-transport

operations.expected: DevTools CLI reports an authenticated session
operations.actual: {"login":true} with IDE server listening on http://127.0.0.1:32562

operations.expected: The imported existing project opens in the IDE
operations.actual: exit 0, "✔ open"; workspace config resolved to AppID wx746a39363f67ae95

operations.expected: Native TypeScript compile succeeds and a preview package is produced
operations.actual: exit 0, "✔ Using AppID: wx746a39363f67ae95", "✔ preview", TOTAL 370 B

operations.actual: CLI reported __NO_NODE_MODULES__ because the bootstrap page imports no npm package yet; packaging becomes applicable with the typed client at T007. CLI prints API errors with process exit 0

operations.expected: Bootstrap page renders the engineering marker with no red compile-error overlay
operations.actual: Owner observed the Simulator displaying "FE-001 bootstrap" with no red error
